{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate rows: {duplicates}')

# Check the unique values in the status column
status_counts = sales_df['status'].value_counts()
print(f'Status distribution:\n{status_counts}')

# Check the revenue column for non-numeric values
revenue_sample = sales_df['revenue'].sample(10)
print(f'Sample of revenue values:\n{revenue_sample}')"}
